subject: SIG package: batch delivery, proof-of-possession screenshots, and screen-share
messages:
From: Alex Stuart <alex.stuart@luminahealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Lumina Health Security <security@luminahealth.com>, Ricardo Varela <ricardo.varela@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:12:00Z
Subject: SIG follow-up & evidence: request for batch delivery and PoP screenshots

Hi Dylan —

Thanks again for submitting the completed SIG spreadsheet yesterday. Our InfoSec team is trying to close the artifact list this week. A couple of asks so we can move to the Evidence Review phase:

- Can you deliver a single manifest (CSV or PDF) listing all artifacts you're providing, with short descriptions and the intended redaction level (none/partial/full)?
- We need "proof-of-possession" screenshots for the following controls: RBAC (showing a role binding and recent access event), KMS key policy summary, and a short snippet from the incident response runbook showing the initial triage steps. Screenshots are fine if they are short-lived links.
- Please provide Drive links (view-only) grouped into a single folder and let us know when links are ready.
- Finally, would your team be available for a 30-minute screen-share to walk through the runbook and the RBAC screenshot (we prefer PST mornings).

Appreciate it — fastest route to close is to have everything in one batch.

Best,
Alex

Attachments: none

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Stuart <alex.stuart@luminahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up & evidence: request for batch delivery and PoP screenshots

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can deliver everything in a single batch. High-level plan:

1) Manifest: we will produce a CSV manifest with artifact name, short description, redaction recommendation, and file name.
2) PoP screenshots: Ben will capture RBAC console view + CloudTrail event snippet; Marissa will extract the incident-runbook snippet and produce a redacted PDF.
3) Drive: we will stage artifacts in a single folder and share a view-only link; TTL set to 90 days unless you request otherwise.
4) Screen-share: we can do a 30-min walk-through on Thu 2026-08-24 09:30 PST (16:30 UTC) — does that work for your team?

Open items for you: please confirm redaction rules around KMS key material (we will not share keys or ARN secrets, just policy summaries). Also confirm whether "proof-of-possession" screenshots should include blurred user emails.

I'll attach the manifest and provisional upload plan to this thread once Ben/Marissa confirm.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Trust & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Alex Stuart <alex.stuart@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up & evidence: request for batch delivery and PoP screenshots

Folks — quick task split and notes:

- Ben: please capture RBAC screenshot (show role binding and the associated Access Activity log line). Use screenshots with user email blurred; include a separate CloudTrail export CSV for the event ID.
- Me: I'll pull the incident runbook snippet that covers initial triage and contain a single redacted page for delivery. Will include a small PDF extract (Runbook-Session-RBAC-snippet.pdf).
- Dylan: can you prepare the manifest (CSV) and create the Drive folder with the naming convention: REDWOOD_SIG_Lumina_20260822. Set link to view-only and disable download if Lumina prefers.

Redaction notes: we will not include full KMS policies with key material. We can include a policy summary screenshot and the key alias listing. If Lumina wants a redacted version of the full policy, we can provide it under an NDA addendum — flagging now.

Ben — target to upload initial artifacts by tomorrow EOD (2026-08-23, PDT).

Marissa

Attachments: Runbook-Session-RBAC-snippet.pdf (pending)

From: Alex Stuart <alex.stuart@luminahealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Lumina Health Security <security@luminahealth.com>, Ricardo Varela <ricardo.varela@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T20:47:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up & evidence: request for batch delivery and PoP screenshots

Thanks — Thu 09:30 PST works for us. A couple of clarifications:

- View-only + disable download is perfect. If you have to enable download for any artifact (e.g., CSV manifest), please mark it as "for compliance review only" in the filename.
- Blurring user emails is fine. For KMS: a policy summary screenshot + alias listing is sufficient. No keys or secrets.
- Please include an Audit Log session recording (or pointer) for the RBAC activity if available. If not, the CloudTrail export will suffice.

We appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Stuart <alex.stuart@luminahealth.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T02:14:00Z
Subject: SIG batch upload: manifest + PoP screenshots + artifacts (initial upload)

Hi Alex / Dylan / Marissa —

Per plan, initial batch uploaded to the share below. Manifest and attachment stubs are included; we'll do a quick check during the screen-share to confirm everything is legible.

Drive folder (view-only): https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1A2b_CSIG-BATCH-20260822

Uploaded items (high level):
- SIG-manifest-REDWOOD-20260822.csv — CSV manifest (Artifact, Description, RedactionLevel, Filename)
- RBAC-proof-of-possession-aws-console.png — screenshot showing role binding; user emails blurred
- cloudtrail-event-EXPORT-evt-7890.csv — CloudTrail export row for the access event
- Runbook-Session-RBAC-snippet.pdf — redacted one-page snippet from incident runbook
- Network-segmentation-diagram.png — network diagram (with sensitive CIDR ranges masked)
- audit-log-session-link.txt — pointer to recorded session (internal retention 30d)

Notes:
- The manifest flags KMS policy excerpts as "summary-only". If Lumina needs the full policy for verification, we'll coordinate an NDA addendum and a restricted transfer method.
- audit-log-session-link.txt contains an internal recording reference (Zoom recording GUID). If you need the recording shared externally, we'll need explicit approval.

Let us know if anything is missing before Thu's screen-share.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments: SIG-manifest-REDWOOD-20260822.csv; RBAC-proof-of-possession-aws-console.png; cloudtrail-event-EXPORT-evt-7890.csv; Runbook-Session-RBAC-snippet.pdf; Network-segmentation-diagram.png; audit-log-session-link.txt

From: Alex Stuart <alex.stuart@luminahealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Lumina Health Security <security@luminahealth.com>, Ricardo Varela <ricardo.varela@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T23:45:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG batch upload: manifest + PoP screenshots + artifacts (initial upload)

Ben / Dylan / Marissa —

Confirmed receipt of the Drive folder and manifest. Quick notes from our side after a cursory pass:

- Manifest looks good; redaction levels are clearly marked.
- PoP screenshot + CloudTrail row are sufficient for the RBAC control (we will keep the recording request internal for now).
- Runbook snippet is acceptable for the initial review. Security will escalate if they need the full runbook.

We will do the Walkthrough on Thu 09:30 PST as scheduled. Please join the Zoom 10 minutes early to confirm screen-sharing permissions.

If anything else changes prior to the meeting, please reply here. Otherwise, we will send back a short "acceptance" note within 48 hours post-walkthrough.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Alex

Attachments: none
